findings.explanation: Actual derived search cache is zero bytes and owned by Administrators (O:BA), unlike the current user. Search is unavailable. Runtime private-file validation refuses it with UNTRUSTED_OWNER.

reproduction.preconditions: Actual installed Bank and retained zero-byte search-cache.sqlite3
reproduction.trigger: Initial rebuild or search/read of that cache
reproduction.observed: INDEX_UNAVAILABLE; explicit guarded repair refused with UNTRUSTED_OWNER before quarantine/write
reproduction.expected: Supported search can build/read a private user-owned index
reproduction.mechanism: The retained file fails ownership and SQLite header checks. File origin/process that created it is unknown.
reproduction.consequence: Search part of FUB10 cannot close; no evidence of lost Bank materials

question.text: Verify the GUI execution context/default owner and select an authorised context for preserving the invalid derived cache and creating a correctly owned index.

findings.explanation: Toolbars were packed after the root expanding main frame, so the submitted screen shows no new editor or safeguard controls.

reproduction.preconditions: Current extended Bank at the submitted screen size
reproduction.observed: Footer visible but panels appended outside expanding outer frame absent
reproduction.expected: Create Entity/Collection/targeted note/edit actions are reachable
reproduction.mechanism: Root pack order gives the expanding main frame available height before later siblings
reproduction.consequence: User cannot start the new object routes

findings.correction: Reserved tools area inside outer frame before expanding panes; object actions use two grid rows; narrower journal chooser
findings.limitations: Technical layout proof only; user must verify visible controls after restart

findings.explanation: The two submitted screenshots show disabled controls/Выполняется: observe versus enabled controls/OK / BANK_OBSERVED. Every two-second observation entered the foreground busy/status path.

reproduction.observed: All controls disable/enable and foreground status changes
reproduction.expected: Quiet background read with user input preserved
reproduction.mechanism: drive called normal submit/model.begin/set_busy for observe and normal model.finish at completion
reproduction.consequence: Periodic flicker and temporarily inaccessible inputs

findings.correction: Observe uses the same Bridge directly without foreground busy/status mutation. One captured foreground request queues behind it; close waits. Sync notice only changes when its text changes.

proposals.action: Silent single-worker observation with one captured pending user action and waiting shutdown
proposals.tradeoffs: Retains one worker; a click may wait for the bounded observation rather than being dropped. Existing explicit actions still show busy.

proposals.action: Move extension controls into reserved main-frame area and split object buttons into two rows
proposals.tradeoffs: Reserves height for reachable controls, reducing the initial list viewport; no capability removed.

proposals.action: Resolve actual cache creation/owner context, preserve the invalid derived file, then rebuild a correctly owned cache with guards enabled
proposals.autonomy_limitation: Current owner guard refuses the file; GUI token/default-owner and creation history are not confirmed. Do not silently change ACLs/owners or use an unsafe bypass.
proposals.tradeoffs: Canonical Bank/materials need no migration; repair waits on the actual ownership/context evidence. Exact effort/calendar delta unknown.

evidence.native_layout: owned withdrawn Tk window, not the main desktop

limitations.text: Static screenshots establish control/status difference, not animation frequency measured from video. Two-second interval verified in code. No user main desktop GUI operated; corrected visible behavior unconfirmed.

Origin of invalid cache and token/default owner of the GUI process are not known. Independent native owned fresh setup creates a valid 32768-byte empty index; that does not repair the existing actual cache.
